svg.title: ZCode LOOP Orchestra Simplified Architecture
svg.desc: Keynote-style architecture of ZCode-ZLoop native multi-agent loop: pre-planning audit, physical concurrency, atomic rollback, and heterogeneous verification.
svg.text: Pre-Planning Counter-Plan · 8–15 Async Worktree Concurrency · Atomic Staging Rollback · Independent GLM-5.3 Gate

g.text: Lowest token cost, highest reasoning leverage
Missing plan record -> Blocked in PLANNING
JIT thread pool dispatch · Non-blocking poll()
Records clean parent_sha baseline before apply
Never trust model self-reports of passing
Never leaves defective commit on Staging HEAD
S-event records candidate SHA for evidence
Atomic transition in SQLite S transaction
>4KB payloads spill to CAS blob store
Evidence-only: reads diffs and test logs
Strict JSON verdict: PASS or REJECT
Or invoke ChatGPT fresh thread review
Git physical oracle asserts clean HEAD
Safe git merge --ff-only to staged SHA
Canonical branch advances to staged commit
Stage transitions to PROMOTED in 1 S tx
Zero poison leakage · Zero unauthorized write

svg.text: ZCode-ZLoop Gen8 · Native Multi-Agent Orchestration Harness · Dual Heterogeneous AI Verification
Confidential & Verified Architecture · Invariants I1–I44 Enforced
